scale_identity_audit.existing_proof:
have hX : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) / d := div_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hd)
rw [trueAlpha, rpow_def_of_pos (zero_lt_one.trans hR)]
rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (log_pos hR).ne', exp_log hX]
scale_identity_audit.mathematical_reason: With R=Q/d>1 and X=N/d>0, R^(log X/log R)=exp(log R*(log X/log R))=X. Existing scale_and_alpha gives alpha>=2, hence R^2<=X.
scale_identity_audit.supplier_FQN_caveat: Inlining a local proof preserves the caller theorem FQN and statement. Moving the public supplier theorem under its own original FQN would require a coherent owner postimage; do not redeclare it in a simultaneously imported module.

target_interfaces.exact_source_statement:
theorem of_prefixWeight_ne_zero {N n dep : ℕ} {t : ℝ} {c : RootCode n}
    {B : (p : ℕ) → Finset (LevelIndex N n .U4 t p dep)} {w : List ℕ}
    (hn : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 11 / 384) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1 / 12)
    (hw : prefixWeight N n dep t c B w ≠ 0) :
    0 < w.prod ∧ (N : ℝ) ^ frozenResidualFloor ≤ cellQ N n c / w.prod ∧
    1 < cellQ N n c / w.prod ∧ (cellQ N n c / w.prod)^2 ≤ (N : ℝ) / w.prod

theorem absolute_all_depth_cell_proper_payment (n : ℕ) (hn : 1/((n:ℝ)+1) ≤ 11/384)
    {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ (t h : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1/12 → 0 < h → h ≤ 1/8 →
      ∀ (B : (dep : Fin 431) → (p : ℕ) → Finset (LevelIndex N n .U4 t p dep.val)),
      norm N * (∑ dep : Fin 431, ∑ c : RootCode n, ∑ p ∈ originalRootCellBand N n .U4 t c,
        ∑ l ∈ B dep p, levelMark l * ∑ s : Split,
          ((properStripTuples N (cellQ N n c) h (levelOccurrence l).current.old s).card : ℝ))
        ≤ ε

theorem allDepthSelectedInnerMass_le_original_add_errors (N n : ℕ) (t h : ℝ)
    (B : (dep : Fin 431) → (p : ℕ) →
      Finset (LevelIndex N n .U4 t p dep.val))
    (hn : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 11 / 384) (hN : 2 ≤ N)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (ht' : t ≤ 1 / 12) (hh : 0 < h) :
    allDepthSelectedInnerMass N n t h B ≤
      (∑ dep : Fin 431, ∑ p ∈ originalBand N .U4, ∑ l ∈ B dep p,
        levelMark l * ordinaryBad N (rootQ N n .U4 t p) (wordProduct l)) +
      allDepthSelectedNoncoprimeMass N n t h B +
      allDepthSelectedProperStripMass N n t h B

theorem actual_selected_profile_le_original_plus_epsilon
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 11 / 384)
    {ε : ℝ} (he : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ h ≤ 1 / 8 ∧
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1 / 12 →
        ∀ (B : (dep : Fin 431) → (p : ℕ) →
          Finset (LevelIndex N n .U4 t p dep.val)),
          norm N * allDepthSelectedProfileMass N n t h B ≤
            norm N * (∑ dep : Fin 431, ∑ p ∈ originalBand N .U4, ∑ l ∈ B dep p,
              levelMark l * ordinaryBad N (rootQ N n .U4 t p) (wordProduct l)) + ε
